codeReview.summary: Implementation fully meets the feature requirements. It successfully checks milestone completion readiness by validating feature statuses and assertion passes. Cancelled features are ignored, and infrastructure features are appropriately exempted from assertion checks. Dynamic file loading is implemented correctly.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker split tests into two files (milestone-gate.test.cjs and milestone-gate-extended.test.cjs) to meet a 500-line ESLint limit.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Worker handoff states: 'Tests split into two files... to meet 500-line ESLint limit'. This 500-line limit constraint on test files is not documented in AGENTS.md.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker manually implemented the assertion check inside `_checkAssertions` instead of directly calling `gatekeeper.canComplete()` during milestone evaluation. Although an exported wrapper `canFeatureComplete` utilizes `gatekeeper.canComplete()`, the main logic duplicates some gatekeeper logic. However, it behaves correctly.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Code in `.claude/lib/mission/milestone-gate.cjs` lines 122-140 iterates over assertion IDs and calls `gatekeeper.getAssertion(assertionId)` directly.

summary: The milestone-gate feature was successfully implemented. All requirements are met, and the implementation exhibits proper defensive programming. A minor test file split was made due to an undocumented ESLint line limit.
